analysis.summary: Akiko Global Services Limited held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call, discussing strong financial performance driven by core business execution, branch expansion, and the development of its digital fintech platform, AkikoPay. Management expressed high confidence in achieving its revenue guidance of INR325 crores to INR350 crores for FY27 and maintaining 70% to 100% CAGR growth over the next three years. The company also highlighted positive demand trends across its unsecured loan and credit card disbursement segments, alongside plans to integrate insurance and mutual funds into AkikoPay. Akiko Global Services Limited reported revenue from operations of ₹6,812.2 lacs and profit after tax of ₹701.6 lacs for Q1 FY27. Operational execution remained strong, with monthly loan disbursals exceeding ₹450 crore and monthly credit card sourcing reaching 17,000 to 18,000 cards.

guidance.claim: Management revised its FY27 revenue guidance upwards to INR325 crores to INR350 crores.
guidance.quote: Earlier, I had given a target of INR300 crores. Now I am revising this guidance. I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects PAT margins for the year to be in the range of 9% to 11%.
guidance.quote: Sir, I am confident of 9% to 11% for this year.

guidance.claim: Management projects a CAGR of 70% to 100% on a year-on-year basis for the next 3 years.
guidance.quote: Because my vision is very clear for the next 3 years that our CAGR will remain the same at 70% to 100% year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Akiko Global management remains confident of achieving revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore for FY27 with healthy profitability.
guidance.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenue growth of 70% to 100% for FY27.
guidance.quote: I would like to give an outlook for FY27, which approximately I am expecting a target of 70% to 100% revenue growth, we have taken a minimum.

guidance.claim: The company targets reaching INR 1,000 crores in revenue by 2030 with PAT margins of 12% to 13%.
guidance.quote: And we have also taken a long-term vision of 2030. We have a proper clear vision that we build INR1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and take PAT margins further to 12% to 13%.

guidance.claim: AkikoPay is expected to contribute around INR 50 crores in revenue in FY27.
guidance.quote: In FY27, I am expecting around INR50 crores revenue from AkikoPay.

guidance.claim: Q1 FY27 revenue is expected to be around INR 65 crores.
guidance.quote: I am expecting INR65 crores to something in between crores in Q1.

guidance.claim: Total revenue guidance for FY27 is expected to be above INR 300 crores.
guidance.quote: Otherwise, I am expecting my outlook for 2027 is INR300 crores. That is not going below INR300 crores, this is going to be above INR300 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: The sourcing pipeline is healthy, providing good visibility for upcoming quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: Bank partnerships are strong, and the sourcing pipeline is healthy, due to which we see good visibility for the upcoming quarters as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Personal loans are currently growing the fastest among all loan products.
Digital lead generation combined with a physical servicing network significantly improves conversion rates from 10% to between 60% and 80%.
demand_outlook.quote: Where our digital conversion rate is 10%, with physical presence, that conversion reaches 60% to 80%, which we have felt over the last two years.

demand_outlook.claim: Dubai operations have started reviving again from April onwards following geopolitical pressures.
demand_outlook.quote: And, it has started reviving again from April onwards.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has 25 branches across 19 cities in India.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we have 25 branches across 19 cities in India.

capex_expansion.claim: Management has a plan for 25 branches in total for the year.
capex_expansion.quote: There is a plan for 25 branches in total.

capex_expansion.claim: The iOS rollout for AkikoPay is currently underway and progressing as planned.
capex_expansion.quote: The iOS version is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its company-owned branch presence in multiple cities including Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Pune, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Lucknow, Kolkata, and Patna.
capex_expansion.quote: Along with this, we have also expanded our company-owned branch presence in multiple cities. Like Delhi NCR is known to everyone, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Pune, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Lucknow, Kolkata, Patna, and many emerging markets.

capex_expansion.claim: Physical branch presence has expanded from 3 or 4 branches in the last quarter to 16 branches across India.
capex_expansion.quote: I mean, where we had three or four branches in the last quarter, today we have 16 branches across India.

margins_costs.claim: In the unsecured loan segment, the average payout is 3.10%.
margins_costs.quote: In unsecured, our average payout itself is 3.10%.

margins_costs.claim: AkikoPay enables customer acquisition at roughly 40% lower cost compared to traditional channels.
margins_costs.quote: ~40% lower CAC vs traditional channels, enabled by a lean, digital-first model

margins_costs.claim: The company maintains a disciplined cost structure with controlled operating burn for AkikoPay.
margins_costs.quote: Disciplined cost structure with controlled operating burn

margins_costs.claim: Total expenses incurred on building AkikoPay technology so far are around INR 1 crore.
margins_costs.quote: Not much, around INR1 crores in total so far on building technology etc, that is it. Nothing more.

orders_capacity.claim: The employee count is projected to reach 1,400 to 1,500 plus by the end of the current quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Sir, our vision is that in this quarter, our employee count should reach 1,400 to 1,500, plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly loan disbursals increased to over ₹450 crore while monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards during Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational execution remained strong during the quarter, with monthly loan disbursals increasing to over ₹450 crore, while monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards, driven by the Company's expanding distribution capabilities, technology-enabled customer acquisition platform, and deep banking and NBFC partnerships.

orders_capacity.claim: AkikoPay has recorded 9,000 monthly active users and 1,000 daily active users.
orders_capacity.quote: MAU (Monthly Active User): 9K | DAU (Daily Active User): 1K, indicating consistent early-stage platform activity

orders_capacity.claim: The company successfully disburses 16,000+ credit cards on a month-on-month basis.
orders_capacity.quote: today we successfully disburse 16,000+ credit cards on a month-on-month basis.

orders_capacity.claim: The monthly loan disbursement run rate has reached INR 400 crores+, bringing the annual book size to INR 5,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, we have reached a monthly disbursement run rate of INR400 crores+, which if we count annually, our book has become INR5,000 crores as of today.

orders_capacity.claim: Total combined workforce, including employees and channel partners, has crossed 900+.
orders_capacity.quote: Reflecting this scale-up, our total combined workforce, including employees and channel partners, has now crossed 900+, which is a very strong growth compared to last year.

capital_allocation.claim: There is absolutely no plan for fundraising right now as internal accruals and bank support are sufficient.
capital_allocation.quote: No, sir. There is absolutely no plan for fundraising right now. Even banks are supporting us very well. So, our CC limits are well aligned. So, no need for any fundraising for the next 6 months or 1 year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Revenue from the Dubai business was impacted due to war, totaling INR1.25 crores for the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: In Dubai, due to war, our total revenue for the entire quarter was INR1.25 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Dubai operations faced temporary margin pressure due to the geopolitical situation around the Iran region.
risks_headwinds.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the Apple App Store version of AkikoPay will be implemented within a week.
management_commitments.quote: Customers are also really liking our new Android version and this same version will be implemented on Apple's App Store within a week.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to reach a maximum number of users on AkikoPay by December.
management_commitments.quote: In terms of users -- look, users I cannot commit, but my vision is to reach a maximum number of users by December.

management_commitments.claim: Integration of insurance and mutual funds into AkikoPay will take 2 months.
management_commitments.quote: That will take 2 months. So, in the next quarter, you will see business visibility for insurance and mutual funds within it.

management_commitments.claim: Receivable days are expected to come down to within 90 days in Q2.
management_commitments.quote: In Q2, I see receivable days coming down to within 90 days.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets reaching around INR1,000 crores in monthly loan disbursement by December end.
management_commitments.quote: Sir, our vision is that in this quarter, our employee count should reach 1,400 to 1,500, plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains confident of achieving its revenue target for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

management_commitments.claim: The iOS version of AkikoPay is expected to offer a comprehensive experience upon launch in the coming months.
management_commitments.quote: The iOS version is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that AkikoPay will most likely be live on iOS with all features within the current month.
management_commitments.quote: So most likely within this month, AkikoPay will be live on iOS with all features.

management_commitments.claim: Ankur Gaba will take on the MD or CEO position in the next quarter.
management_commitments.quote: So, we'll take a -- we'll take a decision very soon and in the next quarter, you will see me as an MD.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets reaching an unsecured loan book of INR 1,000 crores by the end of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: By FY27, my target is INR1,000 crores of unsecured book.

management_commitments.claim: Mutual fund and insurance products are expected to go live on AkikoPay by August onwards.
management_commitments.quote: So mutual fund and insurance going to be live by August onwards because for that I have applied for some IRDAI license.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
